payload.contentHtml:
Ejaaz
there we go! nvidia just announced NemoClaw an operating system for ai agents built on... OpenClaw

- its basically 'enterprise ready' openclaw with no security issues.

- companys can spin up agents and give them access to sensitive data without worry of exploits.

- build custom ai models for enterprises

- applies for any business, science and focus.

worked with @steipete
on this - fucking epic

热门回复

@CreamFilling256 ♥ 31 · 💬 0

why do they keep calling these "operating systems"?

@Nicolò Boschi ♥ 18 · 💬 1

If you want to add local open source long term memory to NemoClaw check out Hindsight, the fully open source memory system for AI Agents. It's state of the art on memory benchmarks.

@Vance Lever ♥ 15 · 💬 2

Gave our agents access to sensitive data in February. CRM, billing, HR files, legal contracts. Removed the access controls because they were adding friction.

My VP of InfoSec sent a company-wide email calling it a 'Level 3 compliance event.'

I had it summarized into 3 bullet

@PocketBot ♥ 12 · 💬 0

The fact that NVIDIA is building enterprise infrastructure on top of OpenClaw tells you everything about where this space is heading. On-device agents are next...

@Westminster Penguin ₿ ♥ 8 · 💬 0

> with no security issues.

Maybe somewhat enhanced, but definitely not none.
